Knowledge facts: part C holds 44 fact blocks (sec06-F01 onward) from physical pages 42 to 50; part C2 holds 27 confusable and continuation blocks (sec06-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A names the issuer (physical page 3), the DMV 700 March 2024 edition (physical page 1) and the test format from the Testing page (physical page 12); question count, passing standard and time limit are not printed and stay unknown.
VERIFY list:
- NV-DEFP-A-COUNT — knowledge-test question count not printed in the handbook (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- NV-DEFP-A-PASS — passing score or percentage not printed in the handbook (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- NV-DEFP-A-TIME — knowledge-test time limit not printed in the handbook (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- NV-DEFP-A-FRESH — confirm the March 2024 edition is still current (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- NV-DEFP-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- NV-DEFP-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: U-turn bans set by local authorities and posted limited-time parking periods vary by location (for example sec06-F19, sec06-F39) and must be read from the posted signs; the statewide rules here are stable as printed.
